critique.evidence: Strong cyber-lab art direction: disciplined charcoal/cyan/red palette, emphatic two-tone headline, crisp cards, and clear narrative hierarchy. Desktop feels polished, but tablet leaves excessive dead space and the connector composition becomes sparse. Mobile loses the desktop’s visual storytelling because connectors disappear and the cards become a generic vertical stack. The global header is notably under-resolved at smaller widths: tablet navigation is visibly clipped, while mobile drops the wordmark and shows an awkward partial “SWIPE →” cue. Tiny, low-contrast monospace labels also weaken legibility and refinement.
critique.fix: Redesign the tablet/mobile header as an intentional compact navigation pattern with a complete scroll cue and preserved brand identity. Tighten tablet vertical spacing, retain a simplified visual connection between evidence cards on mobile, and increase the size/contrast of micro-labels and footer copy.
